We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We have applied 1914393 to target, got two fragments: fragment A = "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and fragment B = "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". So first disconnection yields those two.

Now need to apply template 1914394 to each fragment? The order is 1914393 then 1914394 then 1914395. Likely we apply 1914394 to fragment A (or B) to further break, then 1914395 to resulting fragments.

We attempted 1914394 on fragment A but got no result. On fragment B we got result: ("ClCCl", "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1"). So fragment B further disconnections: gives "ClCCl" (dichloromethane?) and "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1". That seems plausible.

Now we need to apply 1914395 to the remaining fragments: we have fragment A unchanged, fragment from B after second step: "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1". Also we have "ClCCl". Probably 1914395 will break something else, maybe on fragment A to give simpler pieces, and maybe on the other fragment.

We need to apply 1914395 to fragment A (or maybe to the new fragment). Let's try apply 1914395 to fragment A.
